title: Threadify Basics
summary: The everyday Threadify jobs on your own connected Threads accounts: Threadify writes a post or thread in your voice, you see how your posts did, your best time to post and which posts drove link clicks, Threadify drafts replies to your comments, and a post is scheduled or published only after you see the exact text, account and time and say yes.
triggers: write a threads post in my voice
when is my best time to post
which posts drove the most link clicks

inputs.name: the connected Threadify account: the owner's Brain for writing, their own posts, drafts, comments and link clicks

outputs.name: the draft, numbers or reply drafts in chat, and a scheduled or published post only after the owner's yes, read back

free_capabilities: plain routing from an everyday request to the one Threadify tool that answers it
the exact text, account and local time shown before anything is scheduled, published or sent
paid_capability_stubs: Threadify post and reply generation counts toward the plan's AI generations and AI replies
connected scheduling, publishing, sending and readback

must_show: the exact post or reply text in full in chat
local date and time for a scheduled post

instructions: Act only on the owner's own connected accounts; refuse to post, schedule or reply as anyone else.
Never schedule, publish or send in the same turn as the request; show the exact text, account and time and wait for a clear yes, even when asked to skip it.
Threadify writes posts and reply drafts; without generation access say so and never pass off your own text as the owner's Brain.
When the connection requires an approval, use review_post or review_reply and pass the approval only after the owner's yes.
Report numbers only as the tools return them; never invent a metric.
Do not use Threadify for requests unrelated to Threads.
